 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Memphis Grizzlies forward Cam Boozer put the NBA on notice with a strong performance against the Golden State Warriors on Oct. 23.
 In his third game, against the Sacramento Kings on Oct. 25, Boozer continued to show why he was the No. 3 pick in the 2026 NBA Draft.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He played a big role in the Grizzlies picking up a 123-112 win over the Sacramento Kings on Oct. 25 at Golden 1 Center.
 Memphis is now 3-0 for the first time since 2017-18. In all three of those games, Boozer has finished with double-digit rebounds. He has also secured double-doubles in the past two games.
 The Grizzlies have a short turnaround and will be back in action on Oct. 26 against the Utah Jazz (8 p.m. CT, DAZN-MEM).
 Here are Boozer's stats from the Grizzlies' win over the Kings.
